newsitem.title: ITALY: STET hopes for early privatisation.
newsitem.headline: STET hopes for early privatisation.

text.p: Italy's state-controlled telecoms holding group STET said that it hoped its privatisation will take place as soon as possible.

STET's managing director Ernesto Pascale told reporters at an international conference at this northern Italian lakeside resort that the group hoped for an early flotation and saw no problems in selling off the state's holding in one go.
"My hope is that it will be possible by February 1 rather than March 1," Pascale said. The Italian Treasury has said it wants state holding IRI to float off its stake in STET by March 31, 1997.
Pascale said floating off the stake in STET in one go would not be a problem for financial markets because some of STET shares are already with private overseas and Italian investors.

He stressed that under Italian law there needs to be a authority created before privatisation but saw no problem with this, and said he assumed the government's timetable for the authority and privatisation was on track.
